statement: Let E be an isoperimetric region in a complete orientable flat three-manifold, with closed boundary Σ. Either Σ is a union of parallel planar surfaces, or Σ is connected. In the connected case: (i) genus zero gives a round sphere; (ii) genus one gives a flat quotient of a plane or a circular cylinder; (iii) the genus is at most four; (iv) in genus two or three, H2|Σ| ≤ 2π, where H = h/2; in genus four, H = 0.
